mapping.draft_py:
# Boltwave (FDN): "Boltwave deals 3 damage to each opponent."
# The each-opponent damage of FDN Firebrand Archer and M21 Storm Caller (verified): an ALL selector
# over Zone(PLAYER, OPPONENT).
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
        effect=A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
            'amount': QConst(value=3),
            'target': Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),),
            ),
        }),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: Boltwave deals 3 damage to each opponent.

mapping.notes: Each-opponent damage of FDN Firebrand Archer / M21 Storm Caller: ALL over Zone(PLAYER, OPPONENT), 3.
